title: ADC
text: Analog-to-digital converter (ADC), 1 output, {Module} sets Select module to use; {Conversion mode} selects conversion type, {Start of conversion} selects start, {Sample time} sets the interval at which block reads data, {Data type} selects the output data, {Post interrupt at end of conversion} enables to post an asynchronous interrupt, {Use DMA (with C28x3x)} enables to post an asynchronous interrupt, {Conversions no. #} selects ADC channel for each conversion number ADCINA# and {Use multiple output ports} enables to output multiple ports. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Module
params.values: Select module to use A (default) | B | A and B

params.name: Start of conversion
params.values: Select start of conversion Software (default) | ePWMxA | ePWMxB | XINT1_ADCSOC

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Interval at which block reads data 0.1 (default)

params.name: Data type
params.values: Select the output data type uint16 (default) | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | int32 | uint32

params.name: Post interrupt at end of conversion
params.values: Enable to post an asynchronous interrupt Off (default) | on

params.name: Use DMA (with C28x3x)
params.values: Enable to post an asynchronous interrupt Off (default) | on

params.name: Conversions no. #
params.values: Select ADC channel for each conversion number ADCINA# and ADCINB# (default) | ADCINA# | …

params.name: Use multiple output ports
params.values: Enable to output multiple ports on (default) | off
